scope: Simple pair bench inside the full game with a loaded save (original with the class hooks off vs candidate with the hooks on), 16384 isolated CPU pairs for the 75 functions of CVehicleModelInfo, ALL pairs equal, pair counts equal to the bank table, passed=true globally, natural "complete" event with state_restored and layout_ok, saves unchanged, configs restored. Each case rebuilds the same deterministic fixture in both legs and compares the return value, the trace of doubled collaborators with raw arguments, the hash of the fake world, of the arena and of the saved globals, plus per-function fields; the x87 control word is 24 bits; foreign threads ignored. Traced doubles get NO credit. Only the own part of each function is validated. Source tested == current working tree at registration (class sources match the probe build manifest). Historical evidence approved with explicit limits; no current dependency accreditation. Bank limits (VehModelInfoFinal4): static fake world (model infos with the EXE vtable, CVehicleStructure in a fake pool at 0xB4E680, fake TXD 0xC8800C, clumps with type byte 2, frame trees, atomics, geometries, meshes, materials and textures; plugin offsets read from the EXE); traced stubs at the EXE address and at the DLL symbol for RenderWare primitives, CFileMgr/CFileLoader, CTxdStore, CModelInfo::GetModelInfo, random numbers (0x821B1E + CGeneral::GetRandomNumber), operator new/delete, CTimer, scratchpad, the CClumpModelInfo base and the class subfunctions inside CreateInstance/SetClump, none of which gets credit. Masked: SetCarCustomPlate (the EXE passes SetupClump a dword with garbage in the 3 high bytes; only the low byte is traced); SetupCommonData pool byte 0x11 (m_DealWithNoMemory) and the DLL 0xFD filler are not compared (header and states only); the fake CVehicleStructure pool storage is zeroed before SetClump. Outside the fixture: CountCompsInRule with negatives (infinite loop in the EXE), rule nibbles 6..14 (overflow the local list), GetMaximumNumberOfPassengersFromNumberOfDoors(-1) (reads ms_modelInfoPtrs[-1]), LoadVehicleColours with colour lines without '#' (the EXE walks the stack), more than 6 extras. Limits are declared per function in the function-specific scope and in the bank README.
